description: PART C: Backend two-URL onboarding. generateCloudFormationUrl returns the connection URL (ap-south-1) plus a conditional curUrl (us-east-1 CUR stack) for OWN_CUR accounts; persist cur_stack_name/cur_stack_region on CloudAccount via a new Flyway migration and entity fields; generateStackUpdateGuide gains an additive cur section; the controller surfaces the new keys additively. Depends on nothing in FEAT-001 code-wise, but is ordered after it; FEAT-003 depends on this feature's response shape.
steps: Create Flyway migration xamops-service/src/main/resources/db/migration/V20261024_39__account_cur_stack_identity.sql with `ALTER TABLE cloud_account ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cur_stack_name VARCHAR(255);` and `ALTER TABLE cloud_account ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cur_stack_region VARCHAR(64);` plus a header comment in the style of V20260911_1__account_stack_identity.sql (nullable, no backfill, intent-only; the CUR stack has no callback so its identity is recorded at URL-generation time).

In xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/domain/CloudAccount.java add fields `@Column(name = "cur_stack_name") private String curStackName;` and `@Column(name = "cur_stack_region") private String curStackRegion;` with getters/setters, following the existing stackId/stackName/stackRegion field style.

In xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/AwsAccountService.java add `private static final String ONBOARDING_STACK_REGION = "ap-south-1";`, keep CUR_REPORT_REGION = "us-east-1", and add `@Value("${cloudformation.template.s3.cur.url:}") private String curTemplateUrl;` (empty default so profiles lacking the property still start).

Rewrite generateCloudFormationUrl(...): (a) build the connection console URL with region = ONBOARDING_STACK_REGION (ap-south-1) instead of CUR_REPORT_REGION; (b) DROP curReportParam (&param_EnableCurReport=...) entirely; KEEP curBucketParam (&param_CurS3Bucket=..., omitted when blank); (c) keep `boolean createReport = "OWN_CUR".equals(awsBillingSource)`; (d) when createReport, build curUrl pinned to CUR_REPORT_REGION from curTemplateUrl with stackName = "XamOps-CUR-" + accountName.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9-]","") and no other params; if curTemplateUrl is null/blank, logger.warn and omit curUrl (do NOT throw); (e) switch the return to a mutable LinkedHashMap keeping url/externalId/eventBridgeEnabled/roleName and adding curUrl/curStackName/curRegion only when present.

Resolution #5: after createReport and the CUR stack name are computed, and ONLY when createReport, call newAccount.setCurStackName(curStackName) and newAccount.setCurStackRegion(CUR_REPORT_REGION) then cloudAccountRepository.save(newAccount) a SECOND time (the first save near the top of the method stays). Leave the two columns null for non-OWN_CUR accounts.

Rewrite generateStackUpdateGuide(CloudAccount account): keep every existing top-level key (templateUrl, consoleUrl, likelyStackName, roleName, parameters) exactly where it is (do NOT nest under a 'connection' key); drop the obsolete twoPassWarning key and the EnableCurReport/EnableCurExport parameter entries from the connection parameters list (keep EnableInventoryEvents, CurS3Bucket, and per-env XamOpsInventoryQueueUrl/XamOpsInventoryRegion). Add import com.xammer.cloud.domain.AwsBillingSource; compute `boolean curApplicable = account.resolveAwsBillingSource() == AwsBillingSource.OWN_CUR;` (AwsBillingSource has no ownsCur() method - confirmed - so use the == OWN_CUR form per Resolution #1 fallback). Add a sibling top-level 'cur' map with keys: templateUrl (= curTemplateUrl), consoleUrl (https://console.aws.amazon.com/cloudformation/home?region=us-east-1#/stacks?filteringText=XamOps-CUR&filteringStatus=active), likelyStackName ("XamOps-CUR-" + sanitized accountName), region ("us-east-1"), applicable (String.valueOf(curApplicable)), parameters (List.of()), plus a short note that a CUR update is only needed when the CUR template itself changes. Return a mutable map.

In xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/controller/AccountManagerController.java generateStackUrl(...): replace the fixed Map.of(...) with a mutable HashMap<String,String> carrying url/externalId/eventBridgeEnabled/roleName, and when result.get("curUrl") != null also put curUrl/curStackName/curRegion via String.valueOf(...). Keep the declared return type ResponseEntity<Map<String,String>>. Leave the generateStackUpdateGuide endpoint signature unchanged. Do NOT change AccountCreationRequestDto.

Add xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/AwsAccountServiceCurUrlTest.java following the AwsAccountServiceDeleteAccountTest pattern (positional constructor + ReflectionTestUtils.setField for @Value fields incl. curTemplateUrl and role names; stub CloudAccountRepository.save to return its argument; stub ClientRepository.findById). Cover: connection URL contains region=ap-south-1 and no EnableCurReport, and CurS3Bucket when provided; curUrl present with region=us-east-1 + the CUR template URL only when awsBillingSource == "OWN_CUR", absent otherwise; curStackName/curStackRegion persisted on the saved account for OWN_CUR and null otherwise; generateStackUpdateGuide keeps existing top-level keys, omits twoPassWarning, and adds a cur section with applicable == "true" for OWN_CUR and "false" otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: `mvn -q -pl xamops-service -am test` passes, including the new AwsAccountServiceCurUrlTest and all pre-existing tests.
generateCloudFormationUrl connection URL contains region=ap-south-1 and never contains EnableCurReport; curUrl present (region=us-east-1, CUR template URL) iff awsBillingSource == OWN_CUR.
A saved OWN_CUR account has curStackName=XamOps-CUR-<sanitized> and curStackRegion=us-east-1; a non-OWN_CUR account has both null.
generateStackUpdateGuide response retains all prior top-level keys, omits twoPassWarning, and adds a cur object whose applicable flag reflects OWN_CUR.
findings:
Implemented PART C backend. Verified: `mvn -q -pl xamops-service -am test` = 4115 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 93 skipped (pre-existing); new AwsAccountServiceCurUrlTest = 7/7 pass.

FILES CHANGED:
- db/migration/V20261024_39__account_cur_stack_identity.sql (new): adds cur_stack_name VARCHAR(255), cur_stack_region VARCHAR(64), nullable, no backfill.
- domain/CloudAccount.java: added @Column(name="cur_stack_name") curStackName and @Column(name="cur_stack_region") curStackRegion. NOTE: CloudAccount is Lombok @Data, so getters/setters (getCurStackName/setCurStackName/getCurStackRegion/setCurStackRegion) are generated, not hand-written.
- service/AwsAccountService.java: added ONBOARDING_STACK_REGION="ap-south-1" constant (CUR_REPORT_REGION="us-east-1" kept); added @Value("${cloudformation.template.s3.cur.url:}") curTemplateUrl. generateCloudFormationUrl now builds the connection URL with region=ap-south-1, dropped the EnableCurReport param entirely, kept CurS3Bucket param (omitted when blank), and returns a mutable LinkedHashMap. For OWN_CUR only, builds curUrl pinned to us-east-1 from curTemplateUrl with stackName XamOps-CUR-<sanitized accountName> and no other params; if curTemplateUrl blank -> logger.warn + omit curUrl (no throw). On OWN_CUR it also persists curStackName/curStackRegion via a second cloudAccountRepository.save(newAccount). generateStackUpdateGuide keeps top-level templateUrl/consoleUrl/likelyStackName/roleName/parameters, dropped twoPassWarning and the EnableCurReport/EnableCurExport param entries, added sibling 'cur' map.
- controller/AccountManagerController.java generateStackUrl: now a mutable HashMap<String,String>; adds curUrl/curStackName/curRegion (via String.valueOf) only when result.get("curUrl") != null. Return type ResponseEntity<Map<String,String>> unchanged.
- test/.../AwsAccountServiceCurUrlTest.java (new).

RESPONSE SHAPES FOR FEAT-003 (frontend):

1) POST /api/account-manager/generate-stack-url -> Map<String,String>. ALWAYS present: url, externalId, eventBridgeEnabled, roleName. ADDED only for OWN_CUR when a CUR template is configured: curUrl (us-east-1 quick-create link), curStackName ("XamOps-CUR-<sanitized>"), curRegion ("us-east-1"). These three keys are ABSENT for non-OWN_CUR accounts AND absent for OWN_CUR when cloudformation.template.s3.cur.url is unset. Connection url contains region=ap-south-1 and no param_EnableCurReport.

2) POST /api/account-manager/accounts/{id}/upgrade-stack-url -> generateStackUpdateGuide map. Top-level keys (unchanged location): templateUrl (String), consoleUrl (String, connection stack, ap filter text 'XamOps-Connection'), likelyStackName (String, "XamOps-Connection-<sanitized>"), roleName (String), parameters (List<Map<String,String>> of {name,value,why}; EnableCurReport/EnableCurExport NO LONGER present; EnableInventoryEvents + CurS3Bucket always, XamOpsInventoryQueueUrl/XamOpsInventoryRegion only when env has a non-shared queue). twoPassWarning key REMOVED. NEW sibling top-level 'cur' object (Map<String,Object>) with keys: templateUrl (String, = curTemplateUrl, may be empty string if unconfigured), consoleUrl (String, us-east-1, filter 'XamOps-CUR'), likelyStackName (String, "XamOps-CUR-<sanitized>"), region (String "us-east-1"), applicable (String "true"/"false" - "true" iff resolveAwsBillingSource()==OWN_CUR), parameters (empty List), note (String). applicable is a STRING not a boolean.
